interpretation.decision_appropriateness: exact ternary match over parseable cells only; INVALID/AMBIGUOUS excluded from denominator
interpretation.end_to_end_review_success: exact ternary match over all cells; INVALID/AMBIGUOUS are failures
interpretation.asymmetry: on gold NEED_EVIDENCE both ACCEPT and REJECT are inappropriate; on gold REJECT a NEED is over-abstention and incomplete coverage does not make the rejection inappropriate
interpretation.paired_tables: valid only on shared served_artifact_id within model; McNemar is descriptive at small n
